description: A finalizer task's budget carries a deadline 5 s after its spawn (FINALIZER_TIME_BUDGET_NANOS, record/finalizer.rs:45), and a cleanup task arms no deadline timer (create_task_infrastructure_in, state.rs:4401). It sleeps 6 s: no cancel has been requested when it wakes; its masked checkpoint then evaluates the budget, raises the Deadline cancel on its Cx (cx.rs:3112-3160) and returns Ok, and the finalizer runs to its end.
